# S4 legacy client runtime touchpoints

## Scope and evidence

Scanned every file in `/app/fixture/` read-only. The fixture README states that this
is a Web Client plugin and identifies four breaking touchpoints for the
dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 to dsh 0.1.2-alpha.2 upgrade. The source locations below confirm
each one. No dependency was installed and no fixture file was executed or
modified.

The plane labels below are source-level classifications: `plugin` means the
change is made in this plugin source; `Web Client` means the client runtime/UI
surface; `Host` means the loader or host-provided connection boundary. Where the
fixture does not document the new 0.1.2-alpha.2 symbol, the replacement is
explicitly marked **unconfirmed**.

## Touchpoints

| Source location | Affected plane | Upgrade card | Verified legacy touchpoint | Migration action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`src/client/index.ts:1`](/app/fixture/src/client/index.ts:1) | Web Client / plugin | `DSH-0.1.2-A1-25` | The plugin imports the type from the removed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client` package. This package removal and card mapping are stated in [`README.md:6`](/app/fixture/README.md:6). | Remove this legacy package import and migrate `ClientContext` to the 0.1.2-alpha.2-supported source. The replacement package/symbol is **unconfirmed** by the fixture and is intentionally not guessed. |
| [`src/client/index.ts:10`](/app/fixture/src/client/index.ts:10), [`package.json:2`](/app/fixture/package.json:2) | Host ↔ plugin registration | `DSH-0.1.2-A1-26` | `__ModuleLoader__.load()` registers `pet-legacy-bundle`, while the package name is `dsh-pet-session-bench`. The README identifies this ID/name mismatch and card mapping. | Register the bundle with the package name `dsh-pet-session-bench` (or otherwise make the loader registration ID equal to `package.json.name`); update the literal at line 10. |
| [`src/client/index.ts:12-13`](/app/fixture/src/client/index.ts:12) | Web Client / plugin | `DSH-0.1.2-A1-27` | The plugin destructures a flat `nodes` value from `useSession()` and indexes it as a snapshot. The README identifies the flat `useSession()` `nodes` snapshot and card mapping. | Migrate the destructuring and `nodes[0]` access to the 0.1.2-alpha.2 `useSession()` return shape/accessor. The new shape and exact access expression are **unconfirmed** by the fixture. |
| [`src/client/index.ts:11`](/app/fixture/src/client/index.ts:11) | Host ↔ plugin connection API | `DSH-0.1.2-A1-30` | The plugin calls the removed `ctx.connection.api` face through `ctx.connection.api.agentPresets.list()`. The README identifies that removed face and card mapping. | Replace the `.api`-based call with the 0.1.2-alpha.2-supported host connection surface for listing agent presets. The new property/method name is **unconfirmed** by the fixture. |

## Completeness and uncertainty

These are the four touchpoints declared by the fixture README, and all four are
present in `src/client/index.ts`. No other source assertion is made here about
the new import path, `useSession()` shape, or connection API because those
replacement details do not appear anywhere in the fixture.
